svg.text: rival claimant known only from coins —
Every Arsacid king styled himself simply "Arsaces" on his coinage, so individual rulers must be told apart by portrait, mint and monogram rather than by name.
Much of this descent is therefore a numismatic reconstruction, and the links from Vologases I onward are especially provisional — scholars disagree over several of them.
Musa, a woman sent to Phraates IV from Rome, ruled jointly with her son and placed her own portrait on the coinage.
